Synthetic `.et` prefab fixtures for `xtask::map_blueprint::prefab` — written for the tests in
the shipped grammar's shape (class heads, `components`, `SlotBoneMappings`, anonymous child
lists, `$grp` groups, `Hierarchy.PivotID`, `coords`/`angles`/`scale`, door components).
Nothing here is game content; GUIDs and paths are invented.
